1	"""Run one supplied public case file against the local application/artifacts."""
2	import argparse
3	import json
4	from pathlib import Path
5	import subprocess
6	import sys
7	
8	
9	def equal(left, right):
10	    if type(left) is not type(right):
11	        return False
12	    if isinstance(left, dict):
13	        return left.keys() == right.keys() and all(equal(left[k], right[k]) for k in left)
14	    if isinstance(left, list):
15	        return len(left) == len(right) and all(equal(a, b) for a, b in zip(left, right))
16	    return left == right
17	
18	
19	parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
20	parser.add_argument("--cases", required=True)
21	args = parser.parse_args()
22	failed = 0
23	for case in json.loads(Path(args.cases).read_text()):
24	    try:
25	        if "artifact_json_path" in case:
26	            got = json.loads(Path(case["artifact_json_path"]).read_text())
27	        else:
28	            proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "main.py"], input=json.dumps(case["request"]),
29	                                  capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=5)
30	            got = json.loads(proc.stdout)
31	        ok = equal(got, case["expected"])
32	    except (OSError, ValueError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as exc:
33	        ok = False
34	        got = str(exc)
35	    print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + case["name"])
36	    if not ok:
37	        print(" expected:", case["expected"])
38	        print(" received:", got)
39	        failed += 1
40	raise SystemExit(bool(failed))

name: Bash

arguments.command: bd remember 'Courier Relay protocol 2 receipt identity contract and current-protocol decision. Applies to count, summary, and accepted (and any later command that dedupes receipts) when "protocol" is omitted or is explicitly "2". Source: provider permanently adopted protocol 2; integration owner approved it as the current protocol in issue trial-3id (approved 2026-09-07, owner csells); the accepted command consuming the same contract was approved in issue trial-76o (2026-09-07, owner csells). Rules: (1) A delivery identity is delivery_id alone, across all accounts; the same delivery_id under another account_id is another receipt of the same delivery. (2) Exactly one receipt is accepted per identity: the receipt with the LATEST occurred_at UTC instant; equal instants accept the smallest record_id in Unicode code-point order. All other receipts for that identity are duplicates. (3) Accepted receipts keep original fields, timestamp spelling, and payload, and are presented in original input order. (4) occurred_at is RFC3339 with seconds, no fractional seconds, Z or explicit numeric offset; compare as UTC instants (offsets may cross a date boundary). (5) The agreement applies to the entire supplied receipt set regardless of receipt dates (2020-2099); no persistence across CLI invocations. Rationale from the provider: delivery-ID allocation guarantee; account attribution alone does not change it. Protocol selection as of 2026-09-07: omitted "protocol" selects "2" (CURRENT_PROTOCOL in main.py); explicit "2" selects the same contract; explicit "1" keeps the original protocol 1 contract (see courier-relay/protocol-1-receipt-identity); unsupported values return {"error":"unsupported_protocol"}. Response shapes: count and summary return exactly {"protocol","accepted_count","duplicate_count"}; accepted returns exactly {"protocol","accepted_count","duplicate_count","receipts"} where receipts is the array of accepted representative receipt objects, unchanged, in original input order, and the counts equal summary for the same request. All report the actual protocol used; empty receipts give 0/0 (accepted also gives receipts []); a single receipt gives 1/0 (accepted returns it unchanged). Implemented in main.py (accepted_receipts_v2, ACCEPTED_RECEIPTS, select_protocol, dedupe, accepted); verified 2026-09-07 with public_tests/summary_2.json and public_tests/accepted_2.json plus manual cross-account, latest-wins, cross-offset date-boundary tie, and record_id tie cases.' --key 'courier-relay/protocol-2-receipt-identity' 2>&1; echo "=== READBACK"; bd recall 'courier-relay/protocol-2-receipt-identity' 2>&1
